theme: Mutual fund literacy: what is an expense ratio, active vs passive, fund categories
headline: Understanding Expense Ratios in Mutual Funds
body: Expense ratio is the annual cost charged by fund managers to manage investments. Lower ratios mean more returns reach you.
caption: Every fund charges a fee to cover management and operational costs. This percentage directly impacts your wealth accumulation over time. #MutualFundBasics #InvestmentCosts #WealthBuilding #InvestorEducation #SmartInvesting
